object.attr: as implemented: USAGE.md: Mellon doesn't restore these, and deleting a nested repository would lose its history. A symbolic link made since the latest commit is MELLON-STORE-SRS-228's (review Q12).
object.description: If the document's folder holds a nested git repository, or the latest commit holds a symbolic link or submodule in the folder, Mellon shall refuse to discard.
